exposure: Bolus dose of hyperbaric bupivacaine in spinal anaesthesia
Fractional dose of hyperbaric bupivacaine in spinal anaesthesia
outcome: Duration of sensory and motor block
finding: Fractional dosing of spinal anaesthesia provides a longer duration of sensory/motor block and analgesia compared to a bolus dose, with a lower need for ephedrine in patients undergoing vaginal hysterectomy.
